issues.move: Self-serve lever: "campus_content rows, written through the /staff intake form that already publishes to that table" for care_contact and crisis_line, positioned as the thing a campus pastor can change fast without a deploy.
issues.problem: This lever does not exist yet. The claim treats it as an already-working self-serve mechanism, but the intake form and its backend only support a hardcoded, unrelated set of content types, and the read API returns a generic note-shaped record with no fields for the structured data (tel href, hours sentence, named recipient, response promise) the design's own copy requires.
issues.evidence:
/Users/ashleymarkevans/futures-daily-word/netlify/functions/lib/intake-core.js:40  `const CORNER_TYPES = ["announcement", "note", "prayer_point", "essay"];` — no care_contact or crisis_line type exists, and any staff submission with an unrecognised type silently falls back to "announcement" (line 301: `CORNER_TYPES.includes(item.type) ? item.type : "announcement"`).
/Users/ashleymarkevans/futures-daily-word/src/staff/StaffApp.tsx (job 'campus' flow, ~line 367-417) — the campus-corner intake is a free-text "what's on this week / a prayer point" flow with no question type for a phone number, tel: href, hours sentence, or a named-recipient care contact.
/Users/ashleymarkevans/futures-daily-word/netlify/functions/campus-content.js:22-45 — the GET handler returns only {id, type, title, content, author, date}, a generic note shape with nothing for a structured crisis line (number/tel/hours) or care contact (name/inbox/promise).
No supabase/migrations file defines a campus_content schema with any such structured columns; grep across the repo for "crisis_line" and "care_contact" outside this design doc returns zero hits.
The build_steps for this feature (step 4: crisis-lines.ts / lines.json / campus-content.js read; step 5: ComfortCareCard/CrisisLinesSheet/MoreScreen) never touch intake-core.js's CORNER_TYPES or StaffApp.tsx's question set, so the plan as written does not build the lever it claims already exists.
issues.fix: Either (a) explicitly add a build step that extends CORNER_TYPES with care_contact/crisis_line, adds a matching StaffApp.tsx question flow with structured fields (name, inbox, number, tel href, hours sentence), and updates campus-content.js's read/write shape to carry them — making this real dev work, not a governance-only decision — or (b) drop the claim that this is 'the two things a campus genuinely needs to change fast' via an existing lever, and be honest in the design that a campus's crisis line and care contact currently require a developer edit until that work is scoped and built.
